title: Satcom Pathways weekly: 26 Oct to 01 Nov 2026
html:
Highlights from 26 October to 01 November 2026.

New research

  • Africa satcom deals, January 2025 to October 2026: what the tracker shows: Of 36 public deals and milestones tracked, LEO broadband accounts for 16. Regulation is the busiest deal type, and Starlink appears in 8 of the 11 regulatory entries, with outcomes ranging from new licences to a refusal and a court suspension.
  • Starlink licensing across Africa: where things stand: 29 African countries had granted Starlink a licence by May 2026 and 16 more had been announced for 2026 without one. South Africa remains blocked by its ownership rules.
